'''Seng Windrunner''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Windrunner became the leader of the [[Talons]], a [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Talons entered themselves in the [[Cularin Classic]] [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop race]], and Windrunner hired the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] investigator [[Di'hal'uma]] to look into the backgrounds of the other teams participating in the race. He traveled to meet with Di'hal'uma in the [[Dancing Flame Tavern]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Gadrin]], but when he arrived, the Twi'lek was not there, and he learned that a group of thugs had attempted to capture her. Windrunner returned to [[Landing Bay 216]], the Talons' base of operations, and spoke to the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance agents who were investigating the attack on Di'hal'uma.
